# Rust tests allowed to be #[ignore]d in CI (Round 30, read by
# .github/scripts/test-count.sh). One test path per line, as `cargo test`
# prints it. Every entry needs a network, a live sample or a long benchmark,
# so it cannot run in the hermetic job; each one names how to run it in its
# #[ignore = "..."] reason. Adding a line here is a reviewed decision that a
# test stops gating; a new #[ignore] that is not listed fails CI.
#
